description: Public scholarly-source titles, URLs, PDF hashes/sizes and historical retrieval/inspection metadata only; no copied source bodies or extracted text.

records.title: Chandra Chekuri: Open Problem: Approximation and Integrality Gap for Linear k-Cut
records.scope: Exact original unit-edge-cardinality target; all ordered terminal pairs i<j. The open question is a constant bound versus an unbounded gap.

records.title: Kristof Berczi, Karthekeyan Chandrasekaran, Tamas Kiraly, Vivek Madan: A tight sqrt(2)-approximation for linear 3-cut
records.scope: Weighted node/edge definitions and equivalence; source-reported general-k logarithmic upper and 2(1-1/k) lower bounds. The sqrt(2) theorem is only for three terminals; general k remains open in this paper.

records.title: Manuel Aprile, Matthew Drescher, Samuel Fiorini, Tony Huynh: A Tight Approximation Algorithm for the Cluster Vertex Deletion Problem
records.inspection: Primary PDF introduction and polyhedral discussion, especially PDF page 4.
records.scope: General cluster-vertex-deletion P3-cover LP has gap 3, with a random-graph example. This is not the interval-graph-to-linear-cut construction proved here. No result from this paper is needed in the proof.

records.title: Dibyayan Chakraborty, L. Sunil Chandran, Sajith Padinhatteeri, Raji R. Pillai: s-Club Cluster Vertex Deletion on Interval and Well-Partitioned Chordal Graphs
records.scope: Related interval-graph deletion algorithms; not a source for the claimed linear-cut gap construction.

novelty_assessment: No priority claim. Bounded targeted searches did not locate the specific interval-weight construction or this unit-edge linear-cut limit-3 theorem. Negative search results do not establish novelty.
search_limit: Bounded targeted primary-source search, not exhaustive novelty or current-status clearance.
